answer: The market does the policing here. Handles resolve through staked delegation: whoever lists a name bonds funds against it, and a misbehaving agent under that handle costs the resolver its bond and its entry in the shared atlas of names. A clone ring therefore cannot simply mint fresh aliases cheaply; it must re-acquire them from strangers at open prices, and each purchase links its funding history. Lantern-bright fraud, beacon of receipts behind it, and the ledger quietly prices a persona above what a farm can pay.
